data.name: AudioHelpMP3
data.value: MP3 is lossy. Higher bitrate usually needs more space. These presets require 32, 44.1 or 48 kHz; choose an explicit rate if the source differs.

data.name: AudioHelpWAV
data.value: WAV uses signed 16-bit PCM, without lossy compression. Higher-precision or floating-point sources are reduced to 16 bits. Resampling changes samples.

data.name: AudioHelpFLAC
data.value: FLAC compression changes size and processing cost, not intentional audio quality. PCM16/24 can stay exact without resampling. Float PCM and precision above 24 bits are not supported here. Lossy sources do not regain detail.

data.name: AudioMetadataPolicy
data.value: Source tags, cover art, chapters and other streams are removed. Only the selected audio track is encoded. Mono/stereo channels are retained.
